profiles.label: Fossilized space-jockey pilot

requiredAnchors.label: Monumental seated pilot
requiredAnchors.requirement: Huge humanoid remains sit permanently aligned to a pilot station, with scale proved by architecture or explorers.

requiredAnchors.label: Fossilized ribbed pressure suit
requiredAnchors.requirement: Skeletal remains and ribbed biomechanical pressure suit have fused through age while retaining distinct torso, arms and head.

requiredAnchors.label: Trunk-like respirator
requiredAnchors.requirement: A long curved breathing conduit joins facial apparatus to chest or pilot system; it reads as equipment, not an elephant face.

requiredAnchors.label: Integrated pilot chair
requiredAnchors.requirement: Spine, arms, controls and support cradle align functionally in a newly designed cockpit layout.

requiredAnchors.label: Original archaeological view
requiredAnchors.requirement: Camera, chair orientation, chamber plan and lighting do not reconstruct the famous official reveal.

promptDirectives: Invent a new pilot station and archaeological viewpoint while preserving suit-respirator-chair logic.

profiles.label: Pale human-xenomorph newborn

requiredAnchors.label: Pale fleshy giant
requiredAnchors.requirement: A towering pale fleshy body has long heavy limbs, smooth vulnerable tissue and no standard black exoskeletal plates.

requiredAnchors.label: Skull-like near-human face
requiredAnchors.requirement: Deep eye sockets, small original eyes and a skull-like nose area suggest human relation without actor likeness or yautja mandibles.

requiredAnchors.label: Hybrid predatory jaw
requiredAnchors.requirement: A broad organic jaw and predatory teeth integrate with the near-human skull instead of a standard xenomorph dome and inner jaw.

requiredAnchors.label: Distinct newborn body plan
requiredAnchors.requirement: The pale newborn does not acquire an adult's long armored dome, dorsal tubes and bladed tail by default.

promptDirectives: Build an original near-human skull face and pale giant body without performer reference.

profiles.label: White hybrid xenoid

requiredAnchors.label: Pale armored xenoid
requiredAnchors.requirement: Ivory and grey semi-organic armor follows an elongated xenoid skeleton; physical pigmentation remains visible under neutral light.

requiredAnchors.label: Hybrid cranial face
requiredAnchors.requirement: A shortened pale dome and restrained sensory pits distinguish this form from standard adult, Newborn and neomorph heads.

requiredAnchors.label: Coherent elongated limbs
requiredAnchors.requirement: Long humanoid-xenoid limbs and digits remain countable, load-bearing and free of fused anatomy.

requiredAnchors.label: Tapered hybrid tail
requiredAnchors.requirement: A pale segmented tail continues naturally from the pelvis and balances the stance.

promptDirectives: Prove pale material under neutral light and keep this form distinct from Newborn and neomorph.

profiles.label: Alien king royal xenoid

requiredAnchors.label: Massive royal biped
requiredAnchors.requirement: A towering broad biped has heavy limbs and royal scale above warriors but remains more compact than a queen.

requiredAnchors.label: Long crowned cranium
requiredAnchors.requirement: An elongated eyeless head carries a narrow rear-swept royal crest distinct from the queen's broad transverse crown.

requiredAnchors.label: Primary arm-pair anatomy
requiredAnchors.requirement: One dominant arm pair and two legs define the main plan unless the brief explicitly adds secondary royal limbs; no accidental duplicates.

requiredAnchors.label: Heavy royal weapon tail
requiredAnchors.requirement: A long reinforced segmented tail with a large terminal blade counterbalances the royal torso.

requiredAnchors.label: Distinct from queen anatomy
requiredAnchors.requirement: No broad queen crown, egg sac or matriarchal secondary-arm arrangement substitutes for the king profile.

promptDirectives: Use scale, narrow royal crest and body plan to distinguish king from queen and praetorian.
